article.title: Vacancies or defects in appointment not to invalidate orders.
article.content: No act or proceeding of the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission shall be invalid by reason only of the existence of any vacancy amongst its members or any defect in the constitution thereof.
article.html:
64Vacancies or defects in appointment not to invalidate orders.

Section 64 · Chapter IV · page 27 of the Act

No act or proceeding of the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission shall be invalid by reason only of the existence of any vacancy amongst its members or any defect in the constitution thereof.
